'''Pat Keach''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Milford tournament]] on 4 August 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Huntdown Podracing]], according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2780">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-madskills-at-milford-ma-8-04-01d2780/ madskills-at-milford-ma-8-04-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 4 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-madskills-at-milford-ma-8-04-01d2780/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
